name: Review focus item opens the Files changed tab at the cited file
description: From PR #482's Overview tab, confirm the seeded PR Brief's Review focus card renders its first item and that activating it (AC-57) navigates to the Files changed tab with ?tab=diff&file=<path> and shows that file's card (AC-58, AC-71). The seeded first focus item has no line, so no &line= param is asserted. The item sits below the fold inside the app's nested `<main>` scroll container (client/src/vendor/ui/shell/AppFrame.tsx), which agent-browser's viewport-coordinate `click`/`focus`/`scrollintoview` cannot reach — so this flow sets a tall viewport right after load to bring the item on-screen, then clicks it by role (`find role button click`) rather than keyboard-activating a focused element (`find … focus` is not a valid agent-browser subaction). Read-only seeded data (seedBriefDemo, D10) — no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB with the full seed CLI run (see e2e/README.md and e2e/INSIGHTS.md: seedBriefDemo only runs from seed.ts's CLI entrypoint, not from seed()).
